moves.name: Absorb
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Accelerock
moves.description: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Acid
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a spray of harsh acid. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Acid Armor
moves.description: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply raising its Defense stat.

moves.name: Acid Spray
moves.description: The user spits fluid that works to melt the target. This harshly reduces the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Acrobatics
moves.description: The user nimbly strikes the foe. This attack does more damage if the user is not holding an item.

moves.name: Acupressure
moves.description: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its stats.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the foe with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.

moves.name: Aeroblast
moves.description: A vortex of air is shot at the target to inflict damage. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: After You
moves.description: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. It sharply boosts the Speed stat.

moves.name: Air Cutter
moves.description: The user launches razor-like wind to slash the opposing team. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Alluring Voice
moves.description: Attacks using an angelic voice. This confuses the target if its stats have been raised this turn.

moves.name: Ally Switch
moves.description: The user teleports using a strange power and switches its place with one of its allies.

moves.name: Amnesia
moves.description: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. It sharply raises the user's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Anchor Shot
moves.description: The user entangles the target with its anchor chain. The target becomes unable to flee.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user's stats at once.

moves.name: Apple Acid
moves.description: Attacks with an acidic liquid created from tart apples. This also lowers the target's Sp. Def.

moves.name: Aqua Cutter
moves.description: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Aqua Jet
moves.description: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.

moves.name: Aqua Ring
moves.description: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP on every turn.

moves.name: Aqua Step
moves.description: The user attacks the target using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Aqua Tail
moves.description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

moves.name: Aquatic Rush
moves.description: A barrage of seaweed is launched at the target dealing damage. It also lowers the target's evasiveness.

moves.name: Arm Thrust
moves.description: The user looses a flurry of open-palmed arm thrusts that hit two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Armor Cannon
moves.description: The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def.

moves.name: Armor Forge
moves.description: The user forges armor for itself and its ally's boosting their Defense stats.

moves.name: Aromatherapy
moves.description: The user releases a soothing scent that heals all status problems affecting the user's party.

moves.name: Aromatic Mist
moves.description: The user raises the Sp. Def stat of an ally Pokémon by using a mysterious aroma.

moves.name: Assist
moves.description: The user hurriedly and randomly uses a move among those known by other Pokémon in the party.

moves.name: Assurance
moves.description: If the target has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack's power is doubled.

moves.name: Astonish
moves.description: The user attacks the target while shouting in a startling fashion. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Attack Order
moves.description: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the target. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Aura Sphere
moves.description: The user looses a blast of aura power from deep within its body. This move is certain to hit.

moves.name: Aura Wheel
moves.description: Morpeko attacks and raises its Speed with energy stored in its cheeks. Type changes with the user's form.

moves.name: Aurora Beam
moves.description: The target is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Aurora Veil
moves.description: This move reduces damage from attacks for five turns. This can be used only in a hailstorm.

moves.name: Autotomize
moves.description: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.

moves.name: Avalanche
moves.description: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

moves.name: Axe Kick
moves.description: Performs a downward kick which may confuse the target. The user takes damage if it misses.

moves.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
moves.description: The user stares with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers the target's Attack stat. Always goes first.

moves.name: Baneful Bunker
moves.description: Protects the user from attacks. Also poisons any attacker that makes contact with the user.

moves.name: Barb Barrage
moves.description: Fires toxic barbs which may poison the target. Power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

moves.name: Barrier
moves.description: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.

moves.name: Baton Pass
moves.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, passing along any stat changes.

moves.name: Beak Blast
moves.description: The user heats up its beak before attacking. Making contact in this time results in a burn.

moves.name: Beat Up
moves.description: The user gets all the party Pokémon to attack the foe. The more party Pokémon, the more damage.

moves.name: Belch
moves.description: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.

moves.name: Belly Drum
moves.description: The user maximizes its Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.

moves.name: Bestow
moves.description: The user passes its held item to the target when the target isn't holding an item.

moves.name: Bide
moves.description: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.

moves.name: Bind
moves.description: Things such as long bodies or tentacles are used to bind and squeeze the foe for four to five turns.

moves.name: Bite
moves.description: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. It may make the target flinch.

moves.name: Bitter Blade
moves.description: A spiteful slashing attack. The user’s HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Bitter Malice
moves.description: The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Blast Burn
moves.description: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. The user must rest on the next turn, however.

moves.name: Blaze Kick
moves.description: The user launches a kick with a high critical-hit ratio. It may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Blazing Sprint
moves.description: The user rushes the target while coated in hot flames. This boosts the user's Speed stat.

moves.name: Bleakwind Storm
moves.description: The user attacks with cold winds that cause opposing Pokémon to tremble. This may lower their Speed stats.

moves.name: Blitz
moves.description: The user rushes at the target at lightning speed. It is certain to strike first.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the opposing team. It may also freeze them solid.

moves.name: Block
moves.description: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.

moves.name: Blue Flare
moves.description: The user attacks by engulfing the foe in a beautiful, yet intense, blue flame. It may also burn the foe.

moves.name: Body Press
moves.description: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. Power increases the higher the user's Defense is.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. It may leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Bolt Beak
moves.description: Stabs the target with an electrified beak. Power is doubled if the user attacks first.

moves.name: Bolt Strike
moves.description: The user charges at its foe, surrounding itself with lightning. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

moves.name: Bone Club
moves.description: The user clubs the target with a bone. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Bone Rush
moves.description: The user strikes the target with a hard bone two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Bonemerang
moves.description: The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops to hit the target twice, coming and going.

moves.name: Boomburst
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible, explosive sound.

moves.name: Bounce
moves.description: The user bounces up high, then drops on the foe on the second turn. It may also paralyze the foe.

moves.name: Branch Poke
moves.description: The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply pointed branch.

moves.name: Brave Bird
moves.description: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. The user also takes serious damage.

moves.name: Breaking Swipe
moves.description: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks all foes. This also lowers their Attack stats.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.description: The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Brine
moves.description: If the target's HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.

moves.name: Brutal Swing
moves.description: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

moves.name: Bubble
moves.description: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the opposing team. It may also lower the targets' Speed stats.

moves.name: Bubble Beam
moves.description: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target. It may also lower its Speed stat.

moves.name: Bug Bite
moves.description: The user bites the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

moves.name: Bug Buzz
moves.description: The user vibrates its wings to generate a damaging sound wave. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Bulk Up
moves.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting both its Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by stomping on the ground. It reduces hit Pokémon's Speed.

moves.name: Bullet Punch
moves.description: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Bullet Seed
moves.description: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the target. Two to five seeds are shot in rapid succession.

moves.name: Burn Up
moves.description: To inflict massive damage, the user burns itself out. The user will no longer be Fire type.

moves.name: Burning Bulwark
moves.description: Protects the user from attacks. Also burns any attacker that makes contact with the user.

moves.name: Burning Jealousy
moves.description: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This burns all foes that had their stats boosted this turn.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Camouflage
moves.description: The user's type is changed depending on its environment, such as at water's edge, in grass, or in a cave.

moves.name: Captivate
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target is charmed into harshly lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Ceaseless Edge
moves.description: The user slashes the opponent with its shell blade. May leave spikes around the target.

moves.name: Chaotic Burst
moves.description: The user blasts the target with draconic energy. This may also raise the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Charge
moves.description: The user boosts the power of the Electric move it uses next. It also raises the user's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Charge Beam
moves.description: The user fires a concentrated bundle of electricity. It may also raise the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Charm
moves.description: The user charmingly gazes at the foe, making it less wary. The target's Attack is harshly lowered.

moves.name: Chatter
moves.description: The user attacks using a sound wave based on words it has learned. It may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Chilling Water
moves.description: The user showers the target with frigid water. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Chilly Reception
moves.description: The user tells a chillingly bad joke and switches out. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.

moves.name: Chip Away
moves.description: Seeking an opening, the user strikes continually. The foe's stat changes don't affect the damage.

moves.name: Chloroblast
moves.description: The user launches its amassed chlorophyll to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user.

moves.name: Circle Throw
moves.description: The user throws the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

moves.name: Clanging Scales
moves.description: The user rubs its scales and makes a huge noise. Also lowers the user's Defense stat.

moves.name: Clangorous Soul
moves.description: The user raises all its stats by using some of its HP.

moves.name: Clear Smog
moves.description: The user attacks by throwing a clump of special mud. All status changes are returned to normal.

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.description: The user fights the foe up close without guarding itself. It also cuts the user's Defense and Sp. Def.

moves.name: Coaching
moves.description: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Coil
moves.description: The user coils up and concentrates. This raises its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.

moves.name: Collision Course
moves.description: A massive prehistoric explosion. This move’s power is boosted more than usual if it’s a supereffective hit.

moves.name: Comeuppance
moves.description: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.

moves.name: Confide
moves.description: The user tells the target a secret. The target loses focus and its Sp. Atk stat is lowered.

moves.name: Confuse Ray
moves.description: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.

moves.name: Confusion
moves.description: The target is hit by a weak telekinetic force. It may also leave the target confused.

moves.name: Constrict
moves.description: The foe is attacked with long, creeping tentacles or vines. It may also lower the target's Speed.

moves.name: Conversion
moves.description: The user changes its type to become the same type as one of its moves.

moves.name: Conversion 2
moves.description: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the attack the opponent used last.

moves.name: Copycat
moves.description: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.

moves.name: Core Enforcer
moves.description: If the target has already moved this turn, the effect of its Ability is negated.

moves.name: Corrosive Gas
moves.description: The user surrounds everything around it with highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.

moves.name: Cosmic Power
moves.description: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Cotton Guard
moves.description: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, drastically raising its Defense stat.

moves.name: Cotton Spore
moves.description: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to the foe, harshly reducing its Speed stat.

moves.name: Counter
moves.description: A retaliation move that counters any physical attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

moves.name: Counter Spine
moves.description: The user prepares it's sharp spine for a counter-attack enabling the user to attack first. It fails if the target is not readying an attack, however.

moves.name: Court Change
moves.description: With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on either side of the field.

moves.name: Covet
moves.description: The user endearingly approaches the target, then steals the target's held item.

moves.name: Crabhammer
moves.description: The target is hammered with a large pincer. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Crafty Shield
moves.description: The user protects itself and its allies from status moves with a mysterious power.

moves.name: Cross Chop
moves.description: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Cross Poison
moves.description: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also poison the foe. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. It may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Crush Claw
moves.description: The user slashes the target with hard and sharp claws. It may also lower the target's Defense.

moves.name: Crush Grip
moves.description: The target is crushed with great force. The attack is more powerful the more HP the target has left.

moves.name: Crushing Kick
moves.description: The user attacks with a powerful drop kick. It may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Crystalline Cannon
moves.description: The user fires a sparkling beam of energy at the opponent. It may also raise the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Curse
moves.description: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all the other types.

moves.name: Cut
moves.description: The target is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.

moves.name: Dancing Flames
moves.description: The user strikes the target with bewildering patterns of fire. It may also leave the target confused.

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Dark Void
moves.description: Opposing Pokémon are dragged into a world of total darkness that makes them sleep.

moves.name: Dark Wave
moves.description: The user unleashes a wave of dark energy on the opposing team.

moves.name: Darkest Lariat
moves.description: The user swings both arms and hits the target. Ignores the target's stat changes.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.description: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

moves.name: Decorate
moves.description: The user sharply raises the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats by decorating the target.

moves.name: Defend Order
moves.description: The user calls out its underlings to shield its body, raising its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Defense Curl
moves.description: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.

moves.name: Defog
moves.description: A strong wind blows away the foe's obstacles such as Light Screen. It also lowers their evasion.

moves.name: Destiny Bond
moves.description: When this move is used, if the user faints, the foe that landed the knockout hit also faints.

moves.name: Detect
moves.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Diamond Storm
moves.description: The user whips up a storm of diamonds to damage foes. This may also sharply raise the user's Defense stat.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

moves.name: Dire Claw
moves.description: The user may critically hit with its ruinous claws. May also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep.

moves.name: Disable
moves.description: For four turns, this move prevents the target from using the move it last used.

moves.name: Disarming Voice
moves.description: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to foes. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Discharge
moves.description: A flare of electricity is loosed to strike the area around the user. It may also cause paralysis.

moves.name: Dive
moves.description: Diving on the first turn, the user rises and hits on the next turn. It can be used to dive in the ocean.

moves.name: Dizzy Punch
moves.description: The target is hit with rhythmically launched punches that may also leave it confused.

moves.name: Doodle
moves.description: The user captures a quick sketch, changing the Abilities of the user and its allies to the target's.

moves.name: Doom Desire
moves.description: Two turns after this move is used, the user blasts the target with a concentrated bundle of light.

moves.name: Double Hit
moves.description: The user slams the target with a long tail, vines, or tentacle. The target is hit twice in a row.

moves.name: Double Iron Bash
moves.description: The user rotates, centering the hex nut in its chest, and then strikes twice. May cause flinching.

moves.name: Double Kick
moves.description: The target is quickly kicked twice in succession using both feet.

moves.name: Double Shock
moves.description: The user attacks by discharging all of its electricity. The user will no longer be Electric type.

moves.name: Double Slap
moves.description: The target is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life-risking tackle. It also damages the user by a fairly large amount, however.

moves.name: Downpour
moves.description: The user summons an intense rain that both deals massive damage and lowers the targets' speed in the rain.

moves.name: Draco Meteor
moves.description: Comets are summoned down from the sky. The attack's recoil harshly reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Dragon Ascent
moves.description: The user soars upward and drops at high speeds. Its Defense and Sp. Def stats are lowered.

moves.name: Dragon Breath
moves.description: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Dragon Cheer
moves.description: The user raises its allies’ critical hit ratio with a draconic cry. This rouses Dragon types more.

moves.name: Dragon Claw
moves.description: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws.

moves.name: Dragon Dance
moves.description: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.

moves.name: Dragon Darts
moves.description: The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two targets, this move hits each one once.

moves.name: Dragon Energy
moves.description: Converts life-force into power to attack. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.

moves.name: Dragon Hammer
moves.description: The user uses its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.

moves.name: Dragon Pulse
moves.description: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.

moves.name: Dragon Rage
moves.description: This attack hits the target with a shock wave of pure rage. This attack always inflicts 40 HP damage.

moves.name: Dragon Rush
moves.description: The user tackles the foe while exhibiting overwhelming menace. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Dragon Tail
moves.description: The user knocks away the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

moves.name: Drain Punch
moves.description: An energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Draining Kiss
moves.description: The user steals the target's HP with a kiss. The user's HP is restored by over half of the damage dealt.

moves.name: Dream Eater
moves.description: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping foe. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user's HP.

moves.name: Drill Peck
moves.description: A corkscrewing attack with the sharp beak acting as a drill.

moves.name: Drill Run
moves.description: The user crashes into its target while rotating its body like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Drum Beating
moves.description: The user plays its drum, controlling roots to attack. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

moves.name: Dual Chop
moves.description: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.

moves.name: Dual Wingbeat
moves.description: The user slams the target with its wings. The target is hit twice in a row.

moves.name: Dynamax Cannon
moves.description: The user unleashes a strong beam from its core.

moves.name: Dynamic Punch
moves.description: The user punches the target with full, concentrated power. It confuses the target if it hits.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the foe erupt with power. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

moves.name: Echoed Voice
moves.description: The user attacks the foe with an echoing voice. If this move is used every turn, it does greater damage.

moves.name: Eerie Impulse
moves.description: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Eerie Spell
moves.description: The user attacks with tremendous psychic power. This also removes 3 PP from the target's last move.

moves.name: Egg Bomb
moves.description: A large egg is hurled at the target with maximum force to inflict damage.

moves.name: Electric Terrain
moves.description: The user electrifies the ground for five turns. Pokémon on the ground no longer fall asleep.

moves.name: Electrify
moves.description: If the target uses a move after being electrified, that move becomes Electric-type.

moves.name: Electro Ball
moves.description: The user hurls an electric orb at the foe. It does more damage the faster the user is.

moves.name: Electro Drift
moves.description: A futuristic electric strike. This move’s power is boosted more than usual if it’s a supereffective hit.

moves.name: Electro Shot
moves.description: A two-turn attack. The user boosts its Sp. Atk and then fires a high-voltage shot.

moves.name: Electroweb
moves.description: The user captures and attacks foes by using an electric net, which lowers their Speed stat.

moves.name: Embargo
moves.description: It prevents the target from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

moves.name: Ember
moves.description: The target is attacked with small flames. It may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Encore
moves.description: The user compels the target to keep using only the move it last used for three turns.

moves.name: Endeavor
moves.description: An attack move that cuts down the target's HP to equal the user's HP.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.

moves.name: Entrainment
moves.description: The user dances to compel the target to mimic it, making the target's Ability the same as the user's.

moves.name: Equilibrium Pulse
moves.description: The user releases a wave of energy that damages the opposing team. It may also make the targets flinch.

moves.name: Eruption
moves.description: The user attacks in an explosive fury. The lower the user's HP, the less powerful this attack becomes.

moves.name: Esper Wing
moves.description: The user slashes with aura-enriched wings which boosts its Speed stat. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Expanding Force
moves.description: The user attacks the target with psychic power. Powers up and hits all foes on Psychic Terrain.

moves.name: Explosion
moves.description: The user explodes to inflict damage on those around it. The user faints upon using this move.

moves.name: Extrasensory
moves.description: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Extreme Speed
moves.description: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This attack always goes before any other move.

moves.name: Facade
