moves.name: Meteor Assault
moves.description: The user attacks wildly with its thick leek. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Meteor Beam
moves.description: Gathers space power and boosts its Sp. Atk stat on the first turn, attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Meteor Mash
moves.description: The target is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. It may also raise the user's Attack.

moves.name: Metronome
moves.description: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

moves.name: Mighty Cleave
moves.description: The user cleaves the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

moves.name: Milk Drink
moves.description: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.

moves.name: Mimic
moves.description: The user copies the move last used by the foe. The move can be used until the user is switched out.

moves.name: Mind Blown
moves.description: The user attacks everything by causing its own head to explode. This also damages the user.

moves.name: Mind Reader
moves.description: The user senses the foe's movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss the foe.

moves.name: Mineral Burst
moves.description: The user attacks by launching out small, sharp minerals at the opposing team.

moves.name: Minimize
moves.description: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply raises its evasiveness.

moves.name: Miracle Eye
moves.description: Enables the user to hit a Dark type with any type of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.

moves.name: Mirror Coat
moves.description: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

moves.name: Mirror Move
moves.description: The user counters the target by mimicking the target's last move.

moves.name: Mirror Shot
moves.description: The user looses a flash of energy from its polished body. It may also lower the target's accuracy.

moves.name: Mist
moves.description: The user cloaks its body with a white mist that prevents any of its stats from being cut for five turns.

moves.name: Mist Ball
moves.description: A mistlike flurry of down envelops and damages the target. It may also lower the target's Sp. Atk.

moves.name: Misty Explosion
moves.description: The user attacks everything around and faints upon using this move. Power increases on Misty Terrain.

moves.name: Misty Terrain
moves.description: The user covers the ground with mist for five turns. Grounded Pokémon can't gain status conditions.

moves.name: Moonblast
moves.description: The user attacks by borrowing the power of the moon. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Moongeist Beam
moves.description: The user emits a sinister ray. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.

moves.name: Moonlight
moves.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moves.name: Morning Sun
moves.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moves.name: Mortal Spin
moves.description: Performs a spin that eliminates certain traps and hazards. This also poisons opposing Pokémon.

moves.name: Mountain Gale
moves.description: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Mud Bomb
moves.description: The user launches a hard-packed mud ball to attack. It may also lower the target's accuracy.

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. It also reduces the target's Speed.

moves.name: Mud Sport
moves.description: The user covers itself with mud. It weakens Electric-type moves while the user is in the battle.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.name: Muddy Water
moves.description: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at the opposing team. It may also lower the target's accuracy.

moves.name: Multi-Attack
moves.description: Cloaking itself in high energy, the user slams into the target. This move's type depends on the held memory.

moves.name: Mystic Ward
moves.description: The user calls on the powers of the earth to boost it and its ally's Sp. Def stat. If Misty Terrain is active it also boosts the user and its ally's Defense stat.

moves.name: Mystical Fire
moves.description: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Mystical Power
moves.description: The user attacks by emitting a mysterious power. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Nasty Plot
moves.description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user's Sp. Atk.

moves.name: Natural Gift
moves.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

moves.name: Nature Power
moves.description: An attack that makes use of nature's power. Its effects vary depending on the user's environment.

moves.name: Nature's Madness
moves.description: The user hits the target with the force of nature. It halves the target's HP.

moves.name: Needle Arm
moves.description: The user attacks by wildly swinging its thorny arms. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Night Daze
moves.description: The user lets loose a pitch-black shock wave at its target. It may also lower the target's accuracy.

moves.name: Night Shade
moves.description: The user makes the foe see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage matching the user's level.

moves.name: Night Slash
moves.description: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: No Retreat
moves.description: This move raises all the user's stats but prevents the user from switching out or fleeing.

moves.name: Noble Roar
moves.description: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers its Attack and Sp. Atk.

moves.name: Nuzzle
moves.description: The user nuzzles its electrified cheeks against the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Oblivion Wing
moves.description: The user absorbs its target's HP. The user's HP is restored by over half of the damage dealt.

moves.name: Obstruct
moves.description: The user protects itself from all attacks. Direct contact lowers the attacker's Defense.

moves.name: Octazooka
moves.description: The user attacks by spraying ink in the foe's face or eyes. It may also lower the target's accuracy.

moves.name: Octolock
moves.description: Locks the target in and prevents it from fleeing. Also lowers the target's Defense and Sp. Def each turn.

moves.name: Odor Sleuth
moves.description: Enables the user to hit a Ghost type with any type of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.

moves.name: Ominous Wind
moves.description: The user blasts the target with a gust of repulsive wind. It may also raise all the user's stats at once.

moves.name: Order Strike
moves.description: The user strikes the target with a blow filled with draconic energy. It may also raise the user's Defense stat.

moves.name: Order Up
moves.description: If used when the user has a Tatsugiri in its mouth, a boost occurs based on its form.

moves.name: Origin Pulse
moves.description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with countless beams of light that glow a deep and brilliant blue.

moves.name: Outrage
moves.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.

moves.name: Overdrive
moves.description: The user attacks all foes by twanging a guitar or bass guitar, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.

moves.name: Overheat
moves.description: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack's recoil sharply reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Pain Split
moves.description: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then equally shares the combined HP with the target.

moves.name: Parabolic Charge
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it. The user's HP is restored by half the damage dealt.

moves.name: Parting Shot
moves.description: With a parting threat, the user lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats. Then it switches out.

moves.name: Pay Day
moves.description: Numerous coins are hurled at the target to inflict damage. Money is earned after battle.

moves.name: Payback
moves.description: If the user moves after the target, this attack's power will be doubled.

moves.name: Peck
moves.description: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.

moves.name: Perish Song
moves.description: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.

moves.name: Petal Blizzard
moves.description: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and attacks everything around it.

moves.name: Petal Dance
moves.description: The user attacks by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

moves.name: Phantom Force
moves.description: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes on the next turn. Hits through protections.

moves.name: Photon Geyser
moves.description: The user attacks with a pillar of light. This move the higher of the user's Attack or Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Pin Missile
moves.description: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Pixie Punch
moves.description: The opponent is struck with a punch enhanced by fairy power. The punch lands without fail.

moves.name: Plasma Fists
moves.description: The user attacks with electrically charged fists. Normal-type moves become Electric-type.

moves.name: Play Nice
moves.description: The user and target become friends. The target loses its will to fight, lowering its Attack stat.

moves.name: Play Rough
moves.description: The user plays rough with the target and attacks it. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Pluck
moves.description: The user pecks the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

moves.name: Poison Fang
moves.description: The user bites the target with toxic fangs. It may also leave the target badly poisoned.

moves.name: Poison Gas
moves.description: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the face of opposing Pokémon. It may poison those hit.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle or arm seeped with poison. It may also poison the target.

moves.name: Poison Powder
moves.description: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust on the target. It may poison the target.

moves.name: Poison Sting
moves.description: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Poison Tail
moves.description: The user hits the target with its tail. It may also poison the target. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Pollen Puff
moves.description: Fires an exploding pollen puff at enemies, or a HP-restoring one at allies.

moves.name: Poltergeist
moves.description: Attacks the target by controlling its item. The move fails if the target doesn't have an item.

moves.name: Population Bomb
moves.description: The user’s fellows gather in droves to perform a combo attack that hits one to ten times in a row.

moves.name: Pounce
moves.description: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Pound
moves.description: The target is physically pounded with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.

moves.name: Powder Snow
moves.description: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. It may also freeze the targets.

moves.name: Power Gem
moves.description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

moves.name: Power Split
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with those of the target.

moves.name: Power Surge
moves.description: The user attacks the target by releasing all the electricity it has stored. The attack's recoil sharply reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Power Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk with the target.

moves.name: Power Trick
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack with its Defense stat.

moves.name: Power Trip
moves.description: The user boasts of its strength. Power increases the more the user's stats are raised.

moves.name: Power Whip
moves.description: The user violently whirls its vines or tentacles to harshly lash the target.

moves.name: Power-Up Punch
moves.description: Striking opponents repeatedly makes the user's fists harder, raising the user's Attack stat.

moves.name: Precipice Blades
moves.description: The user attacks its foes by manifesting the power of the land in fearsome blades of stone.

moves.name: Present
moves.description: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. It restores HP sometimes, however.

moves.name: Pressure Wave
moves.description: The user attacks using a condensed blast of air. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Prismatic Laser
moves.description: The user shoots powerful lasers using the power of a prism. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Psy Barrage
moves.description: The target becomes trapped by psychic energy that bombards the target for four to five turns

moves.name: Psybeam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. It may also cause confusion.

moves.name: Psyblade
moves.description: The user rends the target with an ethereal blade whose power is boosted on Electric Terrain.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Psychic Fangs
moves.description: The user bites the target using psychic capabilities. This can also destroy Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Psychic Noise
moves.description: Attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. Prevents the target from healing for two turns.

moves.name: Psychic Terrain
moves.description: Protects grounded Pokémon from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.

moves.name: Psycho Boost
moves.description: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack's recoil harshly reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Psycho Cut
moves.description: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Psycho Shift
moves.description: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status problems to the target.

moves.name: Psyshield Bash
moves.description: Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into the target. This raises the user’s Defense.

moves.name: Psyshock
moves.description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

moves.name: Psystrike
moves.description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

moves.name: Psywave
moves.description: The target is attacked with an odd psychic wave. The attack varies in intensity.

moves.name: Purify
moves.description: The user heals the target's status condition. If so, it also restores the user's own HP.

moves.name: Pursuit
moves.description: An attack move that inflicts double damage if used on a target that is switching out of battle.

moves.name: Pyro Ball
moves.description: Attacks by igniting a small stone and launching it as a fiery ball. May also burn the target.

moves.name: Quash
moves.description: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.

moves.name: Quick Guard
moves.description: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves. If may fail if used in succession.

moves.name: Quill Barrage
moves.description: The user launches the sharp quills from their back at the target that hit two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Quiver Dance
moves.description: The user performs a beautiful dance. It boosts the user's Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.

moves.name: Rage
moves.description: As long as this move is in use, the user's Attack rises each time the user is hit in battle.

moves.name: Rage Fist
moves.description: The user converts its rage into energy to attack. The move’s power increases every time the user is hit.

moves.name: Rage Powder
moves.description: The user scatters irritating powder to draw attention to itself. Opponents aim only at the user.

moves.name: Raging Blast
moves.description: The user's anger is channeled into a blast that is then fired off at the opponent. It may also raise the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Raging Bull
moves.description: The user charges and destroys enemy barriers. This move’s type depends on the user’s form.

moves.name: Raging Fury
moves.description: The user rampages around spewing flames for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves.

moves.name: Rapid Spin
moves.description: A spin attack that raises the user's Speed and eliminates the effects of Bind, Spikes, etc.

moves.name: Razor Leaf
moves.description: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at the opposing team. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Razor Shell
moves.description: The user cuts the foe with sharp shells. It may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Razor Wind
moves.description: A two-turn attack. Blades of wind hit the foe on the second turn. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Reckless Roll
moves.description: The user rolls toward the target at full speed and rams into them. It also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Recover
moves.description: Restoring its own cells, the user restores its own HP by half of its max HP.

moves.name: Recycle
moves.description: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Reflect Type
moves.description: The user reflects the target's type, making it the same type as the target.

moves.name: Refresh
moves.description: The user rests to cure itself of a poisoning, burn, or paralysis.

moves.name: Relic Song
moves.description: An ancient song appeals to the hearts of those listening. It may also induce sleep.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user's HP and heals any status problem.

moves.name: Retaliate
moves.description: Gets revenge for a fainted ally. If an ally fainted in the last turn, this attack's damage increases.

moves.name: Return
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Revelation Dance
moves.description: The user attacks the target by dancing very hard. The user's type determines the type of this move.

moves.name: Revenge
moves.description: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

moves.name: Reversal
moves.description: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

moves.name: Revival Blessing
moves.description: The user revives a party Pokémon that has fainted and restores half their max HP.

moves.name: Rising Voltage
moves.description: The user attacks with electric voltage rising from the ground. Power is doubled on Electric Terrain.

moves.name: Roar
moves.description: The target is scared off and replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

moves.name: Roar of Time
moves.description: The user blasts the target with power that distorts even time. The user must rest on the next turn.

moves.name: Rock Blast
moves.description: The user hurls hard rocks at the target. Two to five rocks are launched in quick succession.

moves.name: Rock Climb
moves.description: The user attacks the target by smashing into it with incredible force. It may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Rock Polish
moves.description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.description: Large boulders are hurled at the foes to inflict damage. It may also make the targets flinch.

moves.name: Rock Smash
moves.description: The user attacks with a punch that can shatter a rock. It may also lower the foe's Defense stat.

moves.name: Rock Throw
moves.description: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to attack.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: Boulders are hurled at the target. It also lowers the target's Speed by preventing its movement.

moves.name: Rock Wrecker
moves.description: The user launches a huge boulder at the target to attack. It must rest on the next turn, however.

moves.name: Role Play
moves.description: The user mimics the target completely, copying the target's natural Ability.

moves.name: Rollout
moves.description: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

moves.name: Roost
moves.description: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user's HP by up to half of its max HP.

moves.name: Rototiller
moves.description: The user tills the soil to encourage plant growth. This raises the Attack and Sp. Atk of Grass types.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: The user attacks with a song. Others can join in the Round and make the attack do greater damage.

moves.name: Ruination
moves.description: The user summons a ruinous disaster. This cuts the target’s HP in half.

moves.name: Sacred Fire
moves.description: The target is razed with a mystical fire of great intensity. It may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Sacred Sword
moves.description: The user attacks by slicing with its long horns. The target's stat changes don't affect the damage.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.

moves.name: Salt Cure
moves.description: The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage every turn. Steel and Water types take more damage.

moves.name: Sand Attack
moves.description: Sand is hurled in the target's face, reducing its accuracy.

moves.name: Sand Bullet
moves.description: The user shoots a bullet made of sand at the target. This also lowers their Speed stat.

moves.name: Sand Tomb
moves.description: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm for four to five turns.

moves.name: Sandsear Storm
moves.description: The user wraps fierce winds and hot sand around opponents. This may leave them with a burn.

moves.name: Sandstorm
moves.description: Summons a five-turn sandstorm to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types.

moves.name: Scald
moves.description: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. It may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Scalding Horn
moves.description: The user heats up their horns and uses them to attack. It may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Scale Shot
moves.description: Attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. Boosts the user's Speed but lowers its Defense.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly reduce its Speed stat.

moves.name: Scorching Blade
moves.description: The target is slashed with a burning blade-like object. It may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Scorching Sands
moves.description: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also burn the target.

moves.name: Scratch
moves.description: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.

moves.name: Screech
moves.description: An earsplitting screech harshly reduces the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Searing Shot
moves.description: An inferno of scarlet flames torches everything around the user. It may leave the foe with a burn.

moves.name: Secret Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user's environment.

moves.name: Secret Sword
moves.description: The user cuts with its long horn. The odd power contained in it does physical damage to the foe.

moves.name: Seed Bomb
moves.description: The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

moves.name: Seed Flare
moves.description: The user generates a shock wave from within its body. It may harshly lower the target's Sp. Def.

moves.name: Seismic Beam
moves.description: The user channels seismic power into a beam and fires it at an opponent. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Seismic Toss
moves.description: The target is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.

moves.name: Self-Destruct
moves.description: The user blows up to inflict damage on all Pokémon in battle. The user faints upon using this move.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Shadow Bone
moves.description: The user beats the target with a bone containing a spirit. May lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Shadow Claw
moves.description: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Shadow Force
moves.description: The user disappears, then strikes the foe on the second turn. It hits even if the foe protects itself.

moves.name: Shadow Punch
moves.description: The user throws a punch from the shadows. The punch lands without fail.

moves.name: Shadow Sneak
moves.description: The user extends its shadow and attacks the target from behind. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Sharpen
moves.description: The user reduces its polygon count to make itself more jagged, raising the Attack stat.

moves.name: Shed Tail
moves.description: The user creates a substitute and switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Sheer Cold
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a blast of absolute-zero cold. The target instantly faints if it hits.

moves.name: Shell Side Arm
moves.description: Inflicts physical or special damage, whichever will be more effective. May also poison the target.

moves.name: Shell Smash
moves.description: The user breaks its shell, lowering its defenses but sharply raising attacking and Speed stats.

moves.name: Shell Trap
moves.description: The user sets a shell trap. If it is hit by a physical move, the trap explodes and hurt the attacker.

moves.name: Shelter
moves.description: The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

moves.name: Shift Gear
moves.description: The user rotates its gears, raising its Attack and sharply raising its Speed.

moves.name: Shock Wave
moves.description: The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

moves.name: Shore Up
moves.description: The user regains up to half of its max HP. It restores more HP in a sandstorm.

moves.name: Short Circuit
moves.description: The user sprays the target with water that is super-effective on Electric types. This may paralyze the target.

moves.name: Signal Beam
moves.description: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. It may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Silk Trap
moves.description: User spins a silken trap to protect itself. Lowers the Speed of any that make direct contact.

moves.name: Silver Wind
moves.description: The foe is attacked with powdery scales blown by wind. It may also raise all the user's stats.

moves.name: Simple Beam
moves.description: The user's mysterious psychic wave changes the target's Ability to Simple.

moves.name: Sing
moves.description: A soothing lullaby is sung in a calming voice that puts the target into a deep slumber.

moves.name: Sketch
moves.description: It enables the user to permanently learn the move last used by the foe. Once used, Sketch disappears.

moves.name: Skill Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

moves.name: Skitter Smack
moves.description: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Skull Bash
moves.description: The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense in the first turn, then rams the foe on the next turn.

moves.name: Sky Attack
moves.description: A second-turn attack move where critical hits land more easily. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Sky Drop
moves.description: The user takes the foe into the sky, then drops it on the next turn. The foe cannot attack while airborne.

moves.name: Sky Uppercut
moves.description: The user attacks the target with an uppercut thrown skyward with force.

moves.name: Slack Off
moves.description: The user slacks off, restoring its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP.

moves.name: Slam
moves.description: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, etc., to inflict damage.

moves.name: Slash
moves.description: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Sleep Powder
moves.description: The user scatters a big cloud of sleep-inducing dust around the target.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Sludge
moves.description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.

moves.name: Sludge Wave
moves.description: It swamps the area around the user with a giant sludge wave. It may also poison those hit.

moves.name: Smack Down
moves.description: The user throws a stone or projectile to attack. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when hit.

moves.name: Smart Strike
moves.description: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Smog
moves.description: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. It may also poison the target.

moves.name: Smokescreen
moves.description: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. It reduces the target's accuracy.

moves.name: Snap Trap
moves.description: The user snares the target in a snap trap for four to five turns.

moves.name: Snarl
moves.description: The user yells as if it is ranting about something, making the target's Sp. Atk stat decrease.

moves.name: Snatch
moves.description: The user steals the effects of any healing or stat-changing move the foe attempts to use.

moves.name: Snipe Shot
moves.description: The user ignores any effects that redirect moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Snowscape
moves.description: Summons a five-turn snowstorm that boosts the Defense of Ice-type Pokémon.

moves.name: Soak
moves.description: The user shoots a torrent of water at the target and changes the target's type to Water.

moves.name: Soft-Boiled
moves.description: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

moves.name: Solar Blade
moves.description: The user gathers light energy into a blade, attacking the target on the next turn.

moves.name: Spacial Rend
moves.description: The user tears the target along with the space around it. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Spark
moves.description: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Sparkling Aria
moves.description: The user bursts into song, emitting many bubbles. Any burnt Pokémon will be healed by these bubbles.

moves.name: Spectral Strike
moves.description: The user strikes the target with ghostly energy.

moves.name: Spectral Thief
moves.description: The user hides in the target's shadow, steals the target's stat boosts, and then attacks.

moves.name: Speed Swap
moves.description: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.

moves.name: Spicy Extract
moves.description: Emits a spicy extract which raises the target’s Attack and lowers Defense by two stages each.

moves.name: Spikes
moves.description: The user lays a trap of spikes at the foe's feet. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

moves.name: Spiky Shield
moves.description: Protects the user from attacks. Also damages attackers that make contact with the user.

moves.name: Spin Out
moves.description: The user inflicts damage on the target with a furious spin. This harshly lowers the user’s Speed.

moves.name: Spirit Break
moves.description: The user attacks the target with immense force. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Spirit Shackle
moves.description: The user attacks while also stitching the target's shadow to the ground to prevent it fleeing.

moves.name: Spit Up
moves.description: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released all at once in an attack.

moves.name: Spite
moves.description: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

moves.name: Splash
moves.description: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...

moves.name: Spooky Serenade
moves.description: The user sings a haunting tune that causes pain to the target. This also lowers the target's Sp. Def.

moves.name: Spore
moves.description: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.

moves.name: Springtide Storm
moves.description: The user wraps winds of fierce emotion around opponents. This may lower their Attack stats.

moves.name: Static Surprise
moves.description: The user surprises the target with static electricity. It may also lower the target's Defense or Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Stealth Rock
moves.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the foe. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

moves.name: Steam Eruption
moves.description: The user immerses the target in superheated steam. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Steamroller
moves.description: The user crushes its foes by rolling over them. This attack may make the target flinch.

moves.name: Steel Beam
moves.description: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.

moves.name: Steel Roller
moves.description: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails when the ground isn't a terrain.

moves.name: Steel Wing
moves.description: The target is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user's Defense stat.

moves.name: Sticky Web
moves.description: Weaves a sticky net around the opposing team, which lowers their Speed stats upon switching in.

moves.name: Stockpile
moves.description: The user charges up power and raises both its Defense and Sp. Def. The move can be used three times.

moves.name: Stomp
moves.description: The target is stomped with a big foot. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Stomping Tantrum
moves.description: The user attacks driven by frustration. Power increases if the user's previous move failed.

moves.name: Stone Axe
moves.description: The user swings at the opponent with its stone axes. May leave floating rocks around the target.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.description: The user stabs the foe with sharpened stones from below. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Stored Power
moves.description: The user attacks with stored power. The more the user's stats are raised, the greater the damage.

moves.name: Storm Throw
moves.description: The user strikes the target with a fierce blow. This attack always results in a critical hit.

moves.name: Strange Steam
moves.description: The user attacks the target by emitting steam. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Strength
moves.description: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move heavy boulders.

moves.name: Strength Sap
moves.description: The user restores its HP by the target's Attack stat amount. Then lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: String Shot
moves.description: The foe is bound with silk blown from the user's mouth. This silk reduces the target's Speed.

moves.name: Struggle Bug
moves.description: While resisting, the user attacks the opposing Pokémon. The targets' Sp. Atk stat is reduced.

moves.name: Stuff Cheeks
moves.description: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply raises its Defense stat.

moves.name: Stun Spore
moves.description: The user scatters a cloud of paralyzing powder. It may leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Submission
moves.description: The user grabs the target and recklessly dives for the ground. It also hurts the user slightly.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user's decoy.

moves.name: Sucker Punch
moves.description: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the target is not readying an attack, however.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Sunsteel Strike
moves.description: The user slams into the target with the force of a meteor. Can't be stopped by the target's Ability.

moves.name: Super Fang
moves.description: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. It cuts the target's HP to half.

moves.name: Supercell Slam
moves.description: The user drops onto the target with its electrified body. If it misses, the user is hurt instead.

moves.name: Superpower
moves.description: The user attacks the target with great power. However, it also lowers the user's Attack and Defense.

moves.name: Supersonic
moves.description: The user generates odd sound waves from its body. It may confuse the target.

moves.name: Surf
moves.description: It swamps the area around the user with a giant wave. It can also be used for crossing water.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.description: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, it also sharply raises the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Swallow
moves.description: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to heal its HP.

moves.name: Sweet Kiss
moves.description: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

moves.name: Sweet Scent
moves.description: A sweet scent that lowers the foe's evasiveness. It also lures wild Pokémon if used in grass, etc.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the opposing team. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Switcheroo
moves.description: The user trades held items with the target faster than the eye can follow.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user's Attack stat.

moves.name: Synthesis
moves.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moves.name: Syrup Bomb
moves.description: An explosion of sticky candy syrup, which drop the target's Speed stat each turn for three turns.

moves.name: Tachyon Cutter
moves.description: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Tail Glow
moves.description: The user stares at flashing lights to focus its mind, drastically raising its Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Tail Slap
moves.description: The user attacks by striking the target with its hard tail. It hits the Pokémon two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Tail Whip
moves.description: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary and lowering their Defense stat.

moves.name: Tailwind
moves.description: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that ups the Speed of all party Pokémon for four turns.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the foe. It also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Take Heart
moves.description: The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Tar Shot
moves.description: Pours sticky tar over the target, lowering its Speed and making it weaker to Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

moves.name: Tearful Look
moves.description: Gets teary eyed to make the target lose its will to fight. Lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk.

moves.name: Teatime
moves.description: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.

moves.name: Techno Blast
moves.description: The user fires a beam of light at its target. The type changes depending on the Drive the user holds.

moves.name: Teeter Dance
moves.description: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses the Pokémon around it.

moves.name: Telekinesis
moves.description: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.

moves.name: Telekinetic Slam
moves.description: Through the use of psychic powers, the target is slammed into the ground. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when hit.

moves.name: Teleport
moves.description: The user switches place with a party Pokémon. Also warps to the last Pokémon Center visited.

moves.name: Temper Flare
moves.description: The user attacks driven by frustration. Power increases if the user's previous move failed.

moves.name: Tera Starstorm
moves.description: When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon.

moves.name: Terrain Pulse
moves.description: Utilizes the power of the terrain to attack. This move's type and power vary with the terrain.

moves.name: Thief
moves.description: The user attacks and steals the foe's held item simultaneously. It can't steal if the user holds an item.

moves.name: Thorn Trap
moves.description: The user launches a thorny ball at the target dealing damage and preventing it from fleeing.

moves.name: Thousand Arrows
moves.description: This move also hits Pokémon that are in the air. Those Pokémon are knocked down to the ground.

moves.name: Thousand Waves
moves.description: The user attacks with a wave that crawls along the ground. Those it hits can't flee from battle.

moves.name: Thrash
moves.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.

moves.name: Throat Chop
moves.description: The user attacks the target's throat. The target cannot use sound-based moves for two turns.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

moves.name: Thunder Cage
moves.description: The user traps the target in a cage of sparking electricity for four to five turns.

moves.name: Thunder Fang
moves.description: The user bites with electrified fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.

moves.name: Thunder Punch
moves.description: The target is punched with an electrified fist. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Thunder Shock
moves.description: A jolt of electricity is hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Thunder Slash
moves.description: The user slashes the target with an electrically charged claw. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: A weak electric charge is launched at the target. It causes paralysis if it hits.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: A strong electric blast is loosed at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Thunderclap
moves.description: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the target is not readying an attack, however.

moves.name: Thunderous Kick
moves.description: Overwhelms the target with lightning-like movement, then kicks. Lowers the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Tickle
moves.description: The user tickles the target into laughing, reducing its Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Tidy Up
moves.description: Clears hazards and substitutes from the field. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed.

moves.name: Topsy-Turvy
moves.description: All stat changes affecting the target turn topsy-turvy and become the opposite of what they were.

moves.name: Torch Song
moves.description: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Torment
moves.description: The user torments and enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Toxic Spikes
moves.description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the foe's feet. They poison foes that switch into battle.

moves.name: Toxic Thread
moves.description: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target's Speed stat.

moves.name: Trailblaze
moves.description: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. This boosts the user's Speed stat.

moves.name: Transform
moves.description: The user transforms into a copy of the target right down to having the same move set.

moves.name: Tri Attack
moves.description: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. May also paralyze, burn, or freeze the target.

moves.name: Trick
moves.description: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its held item with its own.

moves.name: Trick Room
moves.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

moves.name: Trick-or-Treat
moves.description: The user takes the target trick-or-treating. This adds Ghost type to the target's type.

moves.name: Triple Arrows
moves.description: The user fires arrows which may lower the target’s Defense or make it flinch. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Triple Axel
moves.description: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

moves.name: Triple Dive
moves.description: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target three times in a row.

moves.name: Triple Kick
moves.description: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successive hit.

moves.name: Trop Kick
moves.description: The user lands an intense tropical kick on the target. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Twin Beam
moves.description: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

moves.name: Twister
moves.description: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at the opposing team. It may also make targets flinch.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Upper Hand
moves.description: An attack that hits first and makes the target flinch. Fails if the target isn't using a high priority move.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.

moves.name: V-create
moves.description: With a fiery forehead, the user hurls itself at the foe. It lowers the user's Defense, Sp. Def, and Speed.

moves.name: Vacuum Wave
moves.description: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Vampiric Bite
moves.description: The user bites the target and drains their blood. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Vengeance
moves.description: The user pummels the target with ghostly fury with no regard for itself. It also cuts the user's Defense and Sp. Def.

moves.name: Venom Drench
moves.description: Foes are drenched in an odd liquid that lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed of poisoned Pokémon.

moves.name: Venoshock
moves.description: The user drenches the foe in a special poisonous liquid. Its power doubles if the target is poisoned.

moves.name: Victory Dance
moves.description: The user performs an intense dance to usher in victory, raising its Attack, Defense, and Speed.

moves.name: Vine Whip
moves.description: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.

moves.name: Vise Grip
moves.description: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.

moves.name: Vital Throw
moves.description: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move is guaranteed not to miss.

moves.name: Volt Switch
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Volt Tackle
moves.description: The user electrifies itself, then charges at the foe. It causes considerable damage to the user as well.

moves.name: Water Gun
moves.description: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

moves.name: Water Pledge
moves.description: A column of water strikes the target. When combined with its fire equivalent, it makes a rainbow.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Water Shuriken
moves.description: The user hits the target with throwing stars 2-5 times in a row. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Water Sport
moves.description: The user soaks itself with water. The move weakens Fire-type moves while the user is in the battle.

moves.name: Water Spout
moves.description: The user spouts water to damage the foe. The lower the user's HP, the less powerful it becomes.

moves.name: Waterfall
moves.description: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.

moves.name: Wave Crash
moves.description: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target. This also damages the user.

moves.name: Weather Ball
moves.description: An attack move that varies in power and type depending on the weather.

moves.name: Whirlpool
moves.description: Traps foes in a violent swirling whirlpool for four to five turns.

moves.name: Whirlwind
moves.description: The foe is blown away, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

moves.name: Wicked Blow
moves.description: Strikes with a fierce blow through mastery of the Dark style. Always results in a critical hit.

moves.name: Wide Guard
moves.description: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for a turn. May fail if used in succession.

moves.name: Wild Charge
moves.description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its foe. It also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Wildbolt Storm
moves.description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with a thunderous tempest. This may also leave them paralyzed.

moves.name: Will-O-Wisp
moves.description: The user shoots a sinister, bluish-white flame at the target to inflict a burn.

moves.name: Wing Attack
moves.description: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.

moves.name: Wish
moves.description: One turn after this move is used, the target's HP is restored by half the user's maximum HP.

moves.name: Withdraw
moves.description: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.

moves.name: Wonder Room
moves.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for 5 turns.

moves.name: Wood Hammer
moves.description: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. The user also sustains serious damage.

moves.name: Work Up
moves.description: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

moves.name: Worry Seed
moves.description: A seed that causes worry is planted on the foe. It prevents sleep by making its Ability Insomnia.

moves.name: Wrap
moves.description: A long body or vines are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

moves.name: X-Scissor
moves.description: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

moves.name: Yawn
moves.description: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.

moves.name: Zap Cannon
moves.description: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and cause paralysis.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the foe. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Zing Zap
moves.description: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may also make the target flinch.
